## Hello

I am a Master of Data Science student at the University of British Columbia
(graduating June 2027), here on a **CAD $10,000 MDS Scholarship**. Before that I
studied computer science at National Tsing Hua University in Taiwan, where I spent
three years in the LSA Lab working on AI infrastructure: getting large models to run
well on GPU clusters, on both NVIDIA and AMD hardware.

In the lab I built an **ML-based workload scheduler** that profiles incoming jobs and
uses an XGBoost classifier to route each one to a CPU, NVIDIA, or AMD GPU cluster. I
also ported LLM frameworks such as vLLM and DeepSpeed to **ROCm** so we could run
**LLaMA 70B on AMD MI210 GPUs**, and I built an **on-premise RAG system** for the
campus computer center that tripled serving throughput on 4 H100s.

The same work took me to the world's top student supercomputing competitions. My
teams took **1st place at the APAC HPC-AI Competition** in Sydney, **2nd at ISC High
Performance 2024** in Hamburg, and **3rd at SC24** in Atlanta. Along the way we made
BLOOM inference 11.4× faster and a CFD solver 18.5× faster, and our SC24
reproducibility work became a paper in *IEEE TPDS*.

A summer as a **Data Scientist intern at IBM** showed me the other half of the job:
deciding whether a model is worth deploying at all. Most of what I knew about AI was
on the systems side, so MDS is where I am deliberately building the modelling and
statistics side to match.

I am looking for **full-time new-grad roles starting in 2027**, in Vancouver, Seattle,
the San Francisco Bay Area, or remote, in **AI infrastructure / ML systems**, **machine learning
engineering**, **software engineering**, and **data science**. More on the
[about page](about.qmd), my work is on [projects](projects.qmd), my [resume is here](files/EvanPai_Resume.pdf), and I write about
the program on the [blog](blog.qmd).
